html-text\u0000Open Motion akan berkemba: EditorsHub grows step by step, focused on becoming a flexible, lightweight motion graphics editor with a comfortable workflow.
html-text\u0000Untuk sekarang, Open Moti: EditorsHub is built on the open-source Open Motion engine, which is still evolving quickly. New features, fixes and workflow improvements arrive with every update.
html-text\u0000 dirilis dan kondisinya s: native build: the editor runs fully on your device, offline, and exports straight to your gallery or share sheet.
html-text\u0000Apa itu Opus Framework?: What is the Open Motion engine?
html-text\u0000 yang sedang dikembangkan: Android app for the Open Motion project: a browser-class motion graphics engine that handles video, audio, images, text, compositing, animation, effects, timelines, preview, rendering and export.
html-text\u0000Secara sederhana, Opus me: Because the engine runs on the device's own graphics pipeline,
html-text\u0000Cara kerjanya memakai pen: timelines, keyframes and media respond in real time while you edit.
html-text\u0000Opus juga sudah memperlih: 3D space such as X, Y and Z positioning, cameras, parallax and three-dimensional rotation, plus low-level APIs for
html-text\u0000 seperti posisi X, Y, Z,: GPU rendering and custom GLSL shaders
html-text\u0000motion graphics, animatio: The engine powers the media pipeline of EditorsHub
html-text\u0000Opus bisa menjadi fondasi: and handles timelines, video/audio decoding, playback, compositing, animation, effects, filters, GPU rendering, video export, and the 3D and camera systems.
html-text\u0000 untuk menangani timeline: Because of that engine, EditorsHub does not have to rebuild an entire multimedia stack from scratch, and development can focus on what makes the app its own:
html-text\u0000Kalau Opus nantinya meman: the editor UI, keyframes, timeline, animation workflow, tools, effects and other creative features.
html-text\u0000UI editor, keyframe, time: The engine is built on Kotlin Multiplatform and is designed to run on multiple platforms. Its developer material already covers iPhone, iPad and macOS, while Android and Windows are still in development. Web and backend support are planned.
html-text\u0000Opus berbasis Kotlin Mult: The Open Motion project is also planned to become
html-text\u0000Opus juga direncanakan me: fully open source, and is being prepared for that public release.
html-text\u0000Belum keputusan final: The engine may not stay exactly as it is today.
html-text\u0000Opus belum tentu menjadi: Once the framework is fully released we can judge whether its performance, features, compatibility, licensing and direction fit the needs of EditorsHub.
html-text\u0000 Setelah framework-nya be: For now, EditorsHub keeps growing as a hands-on project while features and ideas are explored.
html-text\u0000Untuk sekarang, Open Moti: Thank you for trying EditorsHub and following it from this early stage.
